name: Zone Area Dashboard
summary: Zone areas grouped by name, category, story, property or classification as cards, a table and charts; highlights groups in Archicad, exports to Excel or CSV.

versions.changelog: Charts: a donut of the share per group, a bar chart of the area per group, the area per story split by the colour-by value and a treemap of the zones, with legends; a click highlights their zones in Archicad. The Excel export adds the area per story as a sheet.
First version: summary cards, a grouped table, highlight and colour by parameter in Archicad, Excel and CSV export.
